CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.

   D. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   D. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting
